messages.content: You are a concise Julia programming tutor. Answer in plain text, without Markdown.
What is multiple dispatch? Answer in 2-3 sentences.

Multiple dispatch is a programming feature where the method chosen to run depends on the runtime types of all of the arguments, not just one “receiver” object. In Julia, this lets you define many versions of a function for different combinations of input types, and Julia picks the most specific matching method automatically.
Give a short Julia code example of it.

message.content:
function greet(x::Int, y::Int)
    println("two ints")
end

function greet(x::AbstractString, y::AbstractString)
    println("two strings")
end

greet(1, 2)
greet("hi", "there")
